where_to_look: The gap between market cap and treasury: ~70.26m shares at $1.05 spot is ~$74m of equity value (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/upxi/statistics/) against 2,174,583 SOL worth ~$213.7m per The Block's treasury tracker (https://www.theblock.co/treasuries/upxi). That is roughly 0.35x gross mNAV. The FY2026 10-K is the first document that states the treasury, the BitGo borrowings against it, and the share count in one place as of a balance-sheet date — the hunter's job is to work out how much of the discount is debt, lock-ups, unregistered/restricted shares or preferred/warrant overhang that the tracker's gross number ignores, and whether the 10-K discloses any of that for the first time.

The financing trail, which moves monthly here. Three events in the last quarter: a ~$19.5m private placement priced 2026-06-22, open-market repurchase of ~2.5m shares during the March quarter, and the BitGo Prime credit facility amended 2026-09-14 (rate 11.5% -> 7.5%, collateral requirement 260% -> 200%, margin call 175% -> 150%, company says >$2m/yr interest saving) — https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/14/3361016/0/en/upexi-amends-bitgo-credit-facility.html. Reconcile the fully diluted share count and the outstanding BitGo principal in the 10-K against those releases; a share count or borrowing level different from what the releases imply is the single most checkable unpriced item.

Accounting for the SOL position in a first annual report. Under ASC 350-60 fair-value crypto accounting the FY2026 P&L will carry large unrealised marks and the staking yield as revenue, so the reported EPS/net income line is close to meaningless and a headline 'miss' is a price-of-SOL artefact. Look instead at (a) stated cash operating expense + interest run-rate versus staking revenue — management said on 2026-05-12 that by 2026-07-01 cash opex plus interest would be below staking revenue at then-current SOL, so the 10-K is the first place that claim can be checked (https://ir.upexi.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/159/upexi-reports-fiscal-third-quarter-2026-financial-results), and (b) any going-concern or covenant language around the BitGo margin-call level.

The legacy consumer-products operating business (~$4.6m revenue in the March quarter, up from $3.2m) is now a rounding error next to the treasury but is the only thing producing non-crypto revenue; a disposal, impairment or discontinued-operations presentation in the 10-K would be new information nobody is modelling with 1 analyst estimate and no published EPS forecast.

Options are effectively unusable as an anchor and the baseline says so: front expiry is 2026-09-18 (1 day), ATM bid-ask is 67% of mid, total OI 11,453 with a 0.06 put/call OI ratio. Do not treat the 11.43% straddle implied move as a market view; it is one strike wide of nothing.
already_in_the_wire: The BitGo facility amendment of 2026-09-14 — rate cut to 7.5%, lower collateral and margin-call thresholds, >$2m annual interest saving — is three days old and was press-released and widely picked up. Do not re-find it; only its balance-sheet consequences in the 10-K are new.
The earnings date and 5:30 p.m. ET call time (2026-09-15 release).
Headline SOL holdings of ~2.17m tokens and the fact that Upexi is one of the largest listed Solana treasuries — tracked publicly and continuously by The Block, CoinGecko and bitcointreasuries.net.
The June 2026 Blueprint staking partnership, the June 2026 Russell Microcap index add, and the ~$19.5m June private placement.
That the stock is down ~86% from its 52-week high and has run up ~19% in 20 days (sealed baseline tape).
names.trades_on: unknown. Only one of the six baseline reaction dates can be verified as an earnings 8-K, so there is no reliable read on which line moves this stock, and the two most recent genuine earnings releases are dominated by treasury/SOL disclosure rather than a guide or an operating result — the 2026-05-12 Q3 release led with SOL-per-share growth, token count +9%, buyback and staking economics rather than revenue or EPS (https://ir.upexi.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/159/upexi-reports-fiscal-third-quarter-2026-financial-results). The hunter should treat 'SOL per share and the cash/interest burn against staking yield' as the plausible driver but must verify it on the 2026-02-10 print (the one confirmed item 2.02 8-K, https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001775194.json) rather than inherit it from me. Note also that day-to-day the stock is a high-beta proxy for the SOL price, so a chunk of any post-print move will not be about the print at all.

Source: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/upxi/statistics/ retrieved 2026-09-17; the page does not print the FINRA settlement date, so treat it as the latest published settlement (most likely 2026-08-31) rather than as of today. A MarketBeat-sourced snippet claiming 12.4m shares / 23.7% / 1.5 days 'as of September 15th' is NOT usable — a 2026-09-15 settlement is not published by FINRA until ~2026-09-24, and the underlying MarketBeat URL in the result set carried a 2025 path, so that figure is very likely a relabelled 2025 article. Either way this is a crowded short in a nano-cap with a 5-day cover: the squeeze risk that cost this stage its worst losses is live here.
names.notes_on_baseline: baseline_history_trustworthy is false. The baseline claims six amc prints from 'exact 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times', but EDGAR's submissions feed (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001775194.json) supports only one of the ones I could check: 2026-02-10, accepted 22:15:30 UTC with items 2.02, 8.01, 9.01 — genuinely amc and genuinely earnings. Against that: (a) the baseline's 2025-11-12 entry lines up with two 8-Ks that day carrying items 8.01/9.01 and no 2.02, while the company's own release put the Q1 FY2026 earnings call on November 11 (https://ir.upexi.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/139/upexi-to-host-first-quarter-2026-earnings-call-on-november), so that -4.73% is probably a day late and possibly attached to a non-earnings 8-K; and (b) the baseline's 2026-05-13 entry does not match the Q3 8-K, which was accepted 2026-05-12 at 20:40:59 UTC (16:40 ET) after a 2026-05-12 release and 5:30 p.m. ET call, so that +9.35% is measured over the wrong session. Upexi files 8.01 current reports constantly — SOL holdings updates, buyback updates, treasury announcements — which is exactly the contamination mode the brief warned about, and it is plainly present. The hunter must NOT use median_abs_move_pct 6.58 or the 2-up-of-6 skew as an earnings base rate; rebuild the history from item-2.02 filings only, or work without one. deadband_pct 3.29 inherits the same defect.
